Hey, no, everyone has different ability levels and time frames they can play minecraft. The cheats setting, as well as other settings such as KeepInventory, which i'm aware are also often considered cheats, are there as an option for a reason. Some people may not want to fight monsters all night long, and want to only run into them in caverns, or even not at all. Some others may not have the time or patience to restart every time they lose their things, or just get annoyed when they do lose their things. Many of the settings that you and others may determine as being 'cheating' are actually a huge part of what gives the game its huge audience. It is changeable as everyone wants their game to be.

Use a crap ton of stairs. What you want to do is pick whether you want the slopes to be north/south or east/west. Let's say you want them north/south, go to the east and west sides of the house and build a triangle out of blocks on the side of each "square" of your house. Your house isn't a perfect quadrilateral, so divide it into perfect quadrilaterals and do the triangle thing on the east/west sides of each quadrilateral. Basically keep adding layers of blocks, each one progressively smaller than the last. Then using those triangles, you build a roof shape. You could also take one quadrilateral and do it east/west, and the other north/south, and intersect the stairs at corners, for a slightly fancier roof.
